subject: Copywriting
title: Luxury for New Audiences
description: Learn Luxury for New Audiences in one minute.

hook.text: China accounts for 35% of global luxury spending.

buildup.text: Dolce & Gabbana's 2018 Chinese campaign was culturally tone-deaf and sparked a massive boycott.

discovery.text: Successful brands like Hermès and Cartier hire local teams who blend Western luxury codes with Chinese cultural values.

twist.text: Chinese Gen Z consumers reject Western luxury framing entirely. They want Chinese luxury brands with Chinese stories.

climax.text: The future of luxury copy is multilingual and multicultural. One voice for every market is dead.

punchline.text: 35% of luxury spending is in China. Copy must be culturally native now.

quiz.question: What happened to Dolce & Gabbana's 2018 Chinese campaign?
options: It was culturally tone-deaf and sparked a boycott
